title: /themes/network shows the Space page and the note email as pictures for all thirteen Network kits
detail: Twenty-six pictures rendered from the real kit (scripts/render/network-kit-shots.render.tsx and .mjs): the Space page wearing each profile's scheme accent (1280x770) and the kit's note email in each profile's scheme (900x1140). The /themes/network preview and cascade read them, the on-the-way frame is gone, and the library lists Network's Spotlight as ready, which it is. The page layout is unchanged (the frame stays Nocturne's); only the Space and Email surfaces change from a placeholder to a picture. The pinned 'soon + 2' count in test/network-theme-page.render.test.tsx is rewritten to the library's own count, on the owner's phrase 'rewrite test LIVE-1751' (2026-10-29).

verify.evidence: The twenty-six pictures exist and the Space and Email surfaces read them.
